messages.text: The H15 Dual isn't on sale yet — the drop date hasn't been announced, so I can't put one in a basket today. At 22.5p a kWh I can run real numbers on the Harlo B30 or Magic Miner 40T instead. Which appeals?

At 22.5p a kWh the B30 costs about £66 a month in power, and stacks roughly 43,000 sats a month — about $36 at today's price. What you're really buying is the block shot: 3.14 BTC, roughly a 0.17% chance over a year, drawn every ten minutes, and you keep the machine.

$899, quiet at ~50 dB, 405 W. Ships November 30, 2026. Want me to build the cart?

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the + Dogecoin numbers for where you live.
